title: Choose the Riggs HD homepage composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Choose which first-viewport structure should become the build law.

options.label: Layered Dossier
options.lineage: gym panorama overlapped by a student advising file
options.thesis: The gym remains the emotional field while the future dossier physically enters it.
options.viewport: Grayscale gym left and center, warm dossier in the right foreground, with the amber pathway running across the floor and bottom rail.
options.risk: The overlap is the most ambitious to reproduce responsively without flattening the physical depth.

options.label: Threshold Doorway
options.lineage: a literal passage from gym floor into advising space
options.thesis: A cobalt doorway makes the transition from sport to future impossible to miss.
options.viewport: A 45/55 split is joined by a full-height cobalt threshold and one continuous amber floor line.
options.risk: The literal doorway is clearer but gives the program photography less dominance.

options.label: Open Case File
options.lineage: one horizontal advising case file holding the entire story
options.thesis: The homepage itself becomes the documented pathway from the game into a future plan.
options.viewport: An oversized open folder spans the screen with verified copy left, real basketball photography right, and five stages across its lower edge.
options.risk: The file metaphor is highly coherent but can feel more academic than athletic if the photo loses scale.
